statements.status_notes: Langfuse 2.x is end-of-life upstream (last release v2.95.12 on 2025-11-18; no further releases). Transitive dependencies are pinned by the upstream pnpm-lock.yaml or built into the migrate binary at compile time. The vulnerable code paths are not reachable through the entrypoint server.js — the npm tree is bundled by Next.js for the standalone runtime which does not invoke these libraries on hot paths. Customers requiring active CVE remediation should adopt the langfuse 3.x DHI variant; this v2 image is published for migration compatibility only.

Frontend npm packages and embedded Go binaries are tracked in the superset-frontend SBOM at /opt/docker/sbom/superset-frontend but are build-time only. The runtime image ships only compiled static assets from /app/superset/static/assets, not node_modules or any binary containing the listed package code.
